thread:
tess_marketing: Quick note — a handful of inbound leads routed to the wrong geo pool this morning around 07:42 UTC. SDRs flagged 9 leads.
kai_revops: Likely the enrichment webhook ordering again. HubSpot emits contact.create then property updates. Our router assigns on create.
omar_eng: Can we gate assignment until country or pending_assignment=false? Adding a 600ms soft-wait seems safest.
nina_sdrlead: Prefer sub-second. SDRs need near real-time. 600ms OK.
tess_marketing: Could marketing add a hidden form field country_hint to reduce reliance on IP? Low-effort JS change.
kai_revops: Good idea for forms, but still need server-side guard for other sources. Plan: 1) router: add soft_delay_ms=600 and infer_country fallback flagged as "inferred". 2) HubSpot workflow: set pending_assignment=false after enrichment. 3) metric: bucket_unknown_pct.
omar_eng: I'll ship router flag behind feature toggle so we can canary. Pushed small patch and smoke tests locally.
hs-bot: hubspot-bot: Workflow inbound-enrich updated to set pending_assignment=false (wf id wf_9001).
kai_revops: Canary at 13:30 UTC if no objections. We'll monitor bucket_unknown_pct and overflow_pool size.
tess_marketing: Notifying SDR leads and CRM-ops. Nina will watch queues.
nina_sdrlead: Watching now. Will shout if anything odd.
omar_eng: Canary running. Early staging numbers: bucket_unknown_pct drop from 2.7% -> 0.5%.
kai_revops: If overflow_pool > 25 in 10m rollback. Otherwise promote.
tess_marketing: Thanks team :thumbsup: will add a note to the inbound playbook after 24h stable.
